chunks: 5636 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Khalid ibn Jarir, from Abu al-Rabi', from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
Regarding the grandfather with maternal siblings, he said:
"Indeed, in the Book of Ali عليه السلام, it is stated that the siblings from the mother inherit one-third along with the grandfather."

key_terms.إِخْوَةٍ لِأُمٍّ: maternal siblings, sharing the same mother
key_terms.كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: the recorded legal knowledge attributed to Imam Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.يَرِثُونَ: they inherit; they receive a legal share of the estate

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of maternal siblings when a grandfather is also present?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance involving a grandfather and maternal siblings. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام states that in the Book of Ali عليه السلام, maternal siblings receive one-third together with the grandfather, making this a concise report in the law of inheritance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5636 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Khalid ibn Jarir from Abu Al-Rabi from Abu Abdullah (as)
regarding the grandfather inheriting alongside maternal siblings.
Imam (as) said: "Indeed, in the Book of Ali (as), it is written that 'the maternal siblings inherit one-third along with the grandfather.'"
